chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Walad Al-Hannat, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah عليه السلام about a man who apostatized from Islam: to whom does his inheritance belong? He said:
His inheritance is divided among his heirs according to the Book of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.عَلَى كِتَابِ اللَّهِ: according to the ruling of the Book of Allah

ai.seo_question: How is the inheritance of an apostate distributed in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the estate of a person who apostatizes from Islam. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام states that his inheritance is distributed among his heirs in accordance with the Book of Allah عَزَّ وَجَلَّ.
